entries.name: Stamp duty on conveyances or transfers on sale of any property (K3 per K100 of the consideration, charged on the purchaser)
entries.statute: Stamp Duties Act Cap. 43:01 s. 36 (conveyance on sale) and Schedule item 7, Schedule replaced by the Stamp Duties Order 2020 (G.N. 86 of 2020, Malawi Gazette Supplement 23 October 2020; commons.laws.africa copy via Wayback 2024-08-03, R4/fetch/p15/mw_stamp_order_gn86_2020.pdf, page 442 read on the page image); the 2014 consolidation (MalawiLII, R4/fetch/p15/mw_sda_2014.txt) had K1.50 per K100. Liability: 'the purchaser or transferee' (Schedule column)
entries.doc: Item 7, conveyance or transfer on sale of any property: K5 to K50, K10 to K100, K20 to K150, K50 to K200; 'Exceeds K200, for every K100 and also for any fractional part of K100: K3'; persons responsible for stamping: the purchaser or transferee. Fifteenth pass.
unsupported: 'for any fractional part of K100' rounding up not applied (at most K3)
the fixed amounts for considerations up to K200
Stamp Duties Orders after 2020 not checked (flag)
conveyances of property other than land and buildings (shares: marketable securities items)
voluntary dispositions (s. 43) charged as conveyances on the value: gifts not modelled

entries.name: Employer social security contributions (public fund)
entries.statute: Pension Act No. 6 of 2023 s. 12 (1) (held mw/law/w5/pension_act_6_2023.txt); US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019 — Malawi
entries.why: MW has no public social-insurance fund: the Pension Act 2023 s. 12 (1) requires 'a minimum of ten per cent by the employer' to a mandatory occupational pension scheme, i.e. individual accounts in privately managed funds (SSPTW: 'Mandatory individual account system'); a compulsory payment to a private fund is not a tax (OECD) and is not modelled. Sickness, maternity and work injury are employer-liability systems through private carriers.
